Q5217.reason: Costco's confirmation made its acceptance expressly conditional on the $50-per-thousand loading charge, so under UCC 2-207(1) it is a counteroffer that Rainmaking has not accepted.

Q8260.reason: Water comes only from reducing oxygen at the end of the electron transport chain, so it stops immediately, while glycolysis still yields pyruvate and some ATP for a time.

Q5585.reason: The question is leading and asked on direct examination of a witness the defendant called, and leading questions are improper there unless the witness is hostile or adverse, so the objection should be sustained.
